mapper.sql: select d.id, d.create_time, d.update_time, d.version, d.event_id, d.event_message_id, d.subscription_id, s.subscription_code, s.subscription_name, s.subscriber_application, s.consumer_group, d.target_topic, d.delivery_status, d.attempt_count, d.next_retry_at, d.last_error, d.kafka_partition, d.kafka_offset, d.published_at from evt_event_delivery d join evt_event_subscription s on s.id = d.subscription_id
